command: R=/home/andreas/frankenstein-repo; git -C $R fetch -q origin main; T=$(mktemp -d); git -C $R archive origin/main scripts/frank_terminal.py tests/test_frank_terminal.py | tar -x -C $T; python3 -m py_compile $T/scripts/frank_terminal.py; cd $T; if command -v pytest >/dev/null; then pytest -q tests/test_frank_terminal.py; else echo PYTEST_MISSING; fi; rm -rf $T; echo FRANK_MAIN_TEST_DONE
